summary: ```markdown # CLO 2025.1 - CLO-SET Update ## Introduction This video introduces the new update of Closet. We have introduced a new function, the sticker editor, to improve your design ability. As in Closet, users can now edit stickers on 3D clothing in Closet. ## Using the Sticker Editor First, enter the content page. On the right side, click the button to enter the new tool. In the 3D toolbar, select the edit sticker tool. Then click the sticker. The sticker will show the shape controller around it. ### Adjusting the Sticker We can use the shape controller to adjust the sticker. First, drag the triangle around the controller. You can adjust the width and length according to the proportion of the picture. Another way to adjust the sticker is by dragging the outer circle around the controller to rotate the picture. Press the center key and the shift key for the controller to adjust the position. ### Material Options Under the material option on the right, select the basic parameters. Click to replace the icon. Select the sticker from the folder and click to open. Now the sticker has been replaced with a new icon. You can also adjust its position, proportion, angle, etc. Through the sticker configuration tool, even those who do not have CLO software can also participate in the design and development. ## Content Analysis Function Now let's introduce another new function: content analysis. Through this function, you can actually check the progress and content activity analysis of the work process. ### Accessing Content Analysis First, go to the content page. Click on the content analysis button in the upper right corner, then you can enter the content analysis page. The work process analysis provides the progress of the work process and the draft of the development cycle. ### Understanding the Delivery Cycle The total delivery cycle in the upper right corner shows the number of days passed since the content was created. The time axis in the middle shows the delivery cycle between each workflow state. This is where the time axis for all workflows is displayed. When the mouse is hovered over a specific workflow, it shows the number of activities in each status. You can see the upload, broadcast, communication, and download of its versions. ### Detailed Activity Analysis Below the time axis, the activity analysis provides a detailed activity date. In the upper right corner, you can switch to the display of a bubble chart or pile chart. You can adjust the display area size by rolling. Through the activity analysis table, you can identify the fundamental reasons for extending the delivery period. We can quickly find out which activities are the most active and support our strategic decisions. ```
